liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd1982-12-31.sbd.miller.77301.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 30 songs; 190 min; rated 3.58/5 by 12 [1]. Said about its sound: Listener describes the standard fare sequence as rocking; Listener praises the jam-packed sound of horns and guitar; Listener notes the third set soundboard is very crisp [14][18][23]
- **gd1982-12-31.148505.mat.tobin.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 25 songs; 164 min [3]
- **gd1982-12-31.FM.azjones.113090.flac16**: FM broadcast; 25 songs; 166 min; rated 3.8/5 by 5 [4]. Said about its sound: FM mix balances horns better, letting the band sparkle; FM recording sounds grittier and funkier than the soundboard [19][21]
- **gd1982-12-31.134487.s3.nak300.schley.flac2448**: audience recording; 6 songs; 36 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [10]

## Around the show

- Listener compares the night's atmosphere to Chicago blues clubs [14]
- Etta James joins Weir, transforming the Lovelight performance [23]
- Garcia asks Weir what song he is playing during the set [23]
- Matthew Kelly joins for C C Rider and Baby What You Want [1]
- John Cippolina plays Not Fade Away with the band [1]
- Matthew Kelly joins for C C Rider and Baby What You Want [2]
- John Cippolina plays Not Fade Away with the band [2]
- Etta James and Tower of Power horns performed in set three [3]
- Listener argues this FM mix is superior to other versions [19]
- Listener finds the FM version more pleasing than the SBD [21]
- Listener prefers the FM mix over the crisp Miller SBD [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1982-12-31.sbd.miller.77301.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Cassettes provided by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Nakamichi 550/Maxell XLIIS-90) [1]
- **gd1982-12-31.148505.mat.tobin.flac16**: transferred by SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (44/16) by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (44/16) [3]. Also: Archive.org user mixed the tape, converted to FLAC in 2019 [3]
- **gd1982-12-31.FM.azjones.113090.flac16**: source: FM Radio Broadcast > Cassete > Wave > Flac [4]
- **gd1982-12-31.134487.s3.nak300.schley.flac2448**: taped by Brian Schley; transferred by Andrew F.; source: 3rd Set AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5 > Hitachi ME Metal tape. Set up FOB, recording by Brian Schley. [10]. Also: Jon Pasternak and Charlie McGuth organized the recording project [10]
